Chat threads as terminals

Features·seedling·proposed·JUL 21, 2026

One XS thread ↔ one kolu terminal, with pesu as the pipe between Xyne Spaces and kolu.

Contents

  • The three parties
  • Traffic

One chat thread ↔ one kolu terminal. First message to the bot creates both. User text goes into the terminal; agent messages (not tools/edits) come back into the thread from the transcript.

pesu is a small daemon beside kolu. It is the only thing that talks to both sides. Config lives next to pesu (env / systemd) — not in the kolu web app.

The three parties

Owns Talks via
Xyne Spaces identity, threads, who may write apps platform (webhook + app API)
pesu thread → terminal map, the pipe webhook server · XS API client · kolu client
kolu PTY, agent, files, transcript lifecycle create · input · transcript events

Traffic

Xyne Spaces → pesu
Signed webhook on mention / DM: who said what, in which thread.

pesu → kolu

  • first message: create terminal + agent; store threadId → terminalId
  • later messages (author only): write text into that terminal

kolu → pesu
New assistant events from the live transcript (same filter as chat-log export).

pesu → Xyne Spaces
postMessage / updateMessage into the thread. Optional deep link to the terminal in kolu.

That’s the whole protocol. No fleet board, no coordinator, no second bot.
